# The 32-bit ARM forms, one template a line: the kind of instruction (the `Op` variant an arm of
# `lift_instr` in crates/ra-asm-lift/src/thumb.rs matches), then the assembly with its operands as
# classes in braces; the instructions of an IT block are separated by `; `. `[name]` opens the
# group whose cases go to cases/<name>.cases; a group named `arm_*` is ARM code, every other group
# Thumb-2, and the writer (`write_arm32_cases` in crates/ra-asm-lift/tests/vectors_gen.rs) expands
# every class over its sample values, assembles the lines with llvm-mc in WSL (thumbv7 or armv7)
# and writes the cases. `arm32_cases` checks the committed Thumb cases against this file and the
# lift's arm list, and that each case decodes to the kind its template names; the ARM cases
# decode by the ARM decoder to the same kinds, and replay through the same lift. Every arm of the lift is named here
# but `Svc` (a system call runs the host's kernel) and `It` (an IT block is written with the
# instruction it predicates).

[alu16]
Alu     adds {Ld}, {Ln}, #{imm3}
Alu     subs {Ld}, {Ln}, #{imm3}
Alu     adds {Ld}, #{imm8}
Alu     subs {Ld}, #{imm8}
Alu     movs {Ld}, #{imm8}
Alu     cmp {Ld}, #{imm8}
Alu     adds {Ld}, {Ln}, {Lm}
Alu     subs {Ld}, {Ln}, {Lm}
Alu     ands {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     eors {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     adcs {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     sbcs {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     tst {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     rsbs {Ld}, {Lm}, #0
Alu     cmp {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     cmn {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     orrs {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     bics {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     mvns {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     movs {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     add {Rd}, {Rm}
Alu     mov {Rd}, {Rm}
Alu     cmp {Rd}, {Rm}
Alu     add {Ld}, sp, #{imm8x4}
Alu     add sp, sp, #{imm7x4}
Alu     sub sp, sp, #{imm7x4}
Alu     add {Ld}, pc
Alu     mov {Ld}, pc
Alu     add {Rd}, sp, {Rd}

Alu     adcs.w {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, rrx
Alu     sbcs.w {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, ror #{shift5}
Alu     ands.w {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, lsl #{shift5}

Alu     orrs.w {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, asr #{shift5}
Alu     orrs.w {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, ror #{shift5}

Alu     itete {cond}; add{cond} {Ld}, {Ln}, {Lm}; sub{ncond} {Ld}, {Ln}, {Lm}; mov{cond} {Ld}, #{imm8}; mvn{ncond} {Ld}, {Lm}
Alu     ittee {cond}; and{cond} {Ld}, {Lm}; orr{cond} {Ld}, {Ln}; eor{ncond} {Ld}, {Lm}; bic{ncond} {Ld}, {Ln}

# ARM code, recorded for the A32 lift to come; the kinds are the ones its arms will match.
[arm_data]
Alu     add{cond} {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}
Alu     adds {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, lsl #{shift5z}
Alu     subs {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, lsr #{shift5s}
Alu     adds {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, ror {Rs}
Alu     movs {Rd}, {Rm}, rrx
Alu     adds{cond} {Rd}, {Rn}, #{aimm}
Alu     cmp {Rn}, {Rm}, asr #{shift5s}
Alu     mvn{cond} {Rd}, #{aimm}
Alu     orr {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, lsl {Rs}
Alu     bics {Rd}, {Rn}, #{aimm}
Alu     tst {Rn}, #{aimm}
Alu     rsbs {Rd}, {Rn}, #{aimm}
Alu     rscs {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}
Alu     adcs {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}
MovWide movw{cond} {Rd}, #{imm16}
MovWide movt {Rd}, #{imm16}
Mul     mul{cond} {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}
Mul     mla {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}, {Ra}
LongMul umull {Rd}, {Ra}, {Rn}, {Rm}
LongMul smlal {Rd}, {Ra}, {Rn}, {Rm}
Div     sdiv {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}
Div     udiv {Rd}, {Rn}, {Rm}
Extend  sxtb {Rd}, {Rm}, ror #{rot}
Extend  uxth{cond} {Rd}, {Rm}, ror #{rot}
Field   ubfx {Rd}, {Rn}, #{lsb}, #{width}
Field   sbfx {Rd}, {Rn}, #{lsb}, #{width}
Insert  bfi {Rd}, {Rn}, #{lsb}, #{width}
Unsupported clz {Rd}, {Rm}
Unsupported rev {Rd}, {Rm}
Unsupported mrs {Rd}, apsr

[arm_mem]
Mem     ldr{cond} {Rt}, [{Rb}, #{off12}]
Mem     ldr {Rt}, [{Rb}, #{off12n}]
Mem     ldrb {Rt}, [{Rb}, {Ri}, lsl #{sh2}]
Mem     ldr {Rt}, [{Rb}, -{Ri}]
Mem     ldrh {Rt}, [{Rb}, #{off8}]
Mem     ldrsb {Rt}, [{Rb}], #{off8}
Mem     ldrsh {Rt}, [{Rb}, #{off8}]!
Mem     ldr {Rt}, [{Rb}], {Ri}
Mem     ldr {Rt}, [{Rb}, {Ri}, lsl #{sh2}]!
Mem     str{cond} {Rt}, [{Rb}, #{off12}]
Mem     strb {Rt}, [{Rb}, {Ri}]
Mem     strh {Rt}, [{Rb}], #{off8}
Mem     str {Rt}, [{Rb}, #{off8}]!
Mem     ldr {Rt}, [pc, #{lit12}]
Dual    ldrd {Re}, {Ro}, [{Rbd}, #{dual8}]
Dual    strd {Re}, {Ro}, [{Rbd}], #{dual8}
Multiple ldm {Rb}!, {wlist}
Multiple ldmib {Rb}, {wlist}
Multiple ldmda {Rb}!, {wlist}
Multiple stmdb {Rb}!, {wlist}
Multiple stmib {Rb}!, {wlist}
Multiple stmda {Rb}, {wlist}
Multiple push{cond} {wlistlr}
Multiple pop {wlistpc}
Multiple pop{cond} {wlist}

[arm_flow]
Branch  b #{alabel}
Branch  b{cond} #{alabel}

Call    bl{cond} #{alabel}
